name: Multidimensional Transfer Function for Multivariate Data
definition: A technique for visualizing multivariate data (multiple scalar values per sample point) by assigning different data values to different axes of the transfer function.
summary: Multidimensional transfer functions visualize multivariate data by assigning components to classification axes and incorporating a first-derivative measure of total local change to isolate features indistinguishable in single-variable spaces.
